Implemented the Python port in [zip_password_finder.py](/C:/Users/liuliu/Documents/tura_workspace/target/project-rebuild-source-port/r-c59274bd46/zip-password-finder/codex-main-1/workspace/zip_password_finder.py), with:

- ZipCrypto verification via `zipfile`

- auto-selection of encrypted files in multi-file archives

Verification: compared against the official reference CLI for version/help, missing args, validation errors, brute force, dictionary, mask, custom charset mask, no-match, and multi-file auto-select cases. All matched after normalizing the inherently variable `Time elapsed:` line.
